name: Speechify
description: Speechify is a leading text-to-speech platform that transforms written content into spoken words, making it easier for users to consume information through audio. It is designed to assist individuals with reading difficulties, busy professionals, and anyone who prefers listening over reading. With a variety of voices and languages, Speechify enhances accessibility and productivity.
